description: This file defines a plugin function for processing challenge questions, specifically parsing video questions with answers and solutions from a markdown AST structure.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function returning the transformer function for processing the AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the markdown AST to extract questions, answers, and solutions, and attaches them to the file data.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a question object from text, answers, and solution nodes.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Parses answer nodes, handling feedback and audio ID sections, and returns answer objects.

methods.name: getSolution
methods.description: Extracts and validates the solution number from solution nodes.
